validation.name: WarmJpegDecode
validation.cancellationBoundary: Live cancelable token, never signaled; token/source setup/disposal outside timing. Native has no equivalent cancellation setting; complete decode/conversion/owned output release remain timed.
validation.boundary: Identical resident prepared 8-bit JPEG to independent owned RGBA8. Public managed Decode, allocation and disposal; native software mjpeg decoder, per-operation state reset, full-range BT.601 conversion, owned output allocation and release. For subsampled inputs, expand both ceil-sized chroma planes by their sampling factors and crop to the original grid inside every operation, including intermediate acquisition/release. Grayscale includes expanding owned decoded GRAY8 samples into independent RGBA8 inside every operation. Native context/conversion/input packet/frame wrappers reused; every call decodes and converts all pixels. Padded native rows are exposed without a gratuitous packing copy. Startup, I/O, IPC, generation, hashing, checks and tight-row file writes excluded. No encoder quality search or additional source raster. Decoder RGB maximum 4/RMSE 1.5, exact opaque alpha.

scope: One current complete operation, immutable current core, existing selector/harness/native and frozen original input/settings. CPU0 target; perf sampler CPU1. One two-second capture; instrumented elapsed values discarded. IP sample skid/inlining limits attribution; shares are not times or predicted savings.
initialAnalysisFailure: Initial parser expected exactly3 whitespace fields and ignored managed DSO names containing spaces. Corrected postprocessing of SAME capture; no rerun.
qualificationReused: Unchanged WSP152 full/live/scalar and SAME actual Release package on Windows/Linux. New retained refinement tests qualified separately. No source or producer changed.
conclusion: Samples span symbol/sign handling, run-position construction and correction execution. These broad code regions include branches and inlined instructions; sample skid prevents per-instruction cost conclusions. Reacquired-byte counts did not establish lookahead publication as the dominant removable cost. No additional scan-state retiming justified.
next: Prioritize complete transparent WebP operation-owned storage/work attribution. A distinct JPEG design should address measured symbol/position/correction work, not merely repeat lookahead reuse. Keep exact errors/pixels and cooperative cancellation; any policy proposal must be explicit.
